title: [review] lib.rs:203: Type inconsistency betwee
description: select_channel() takes epoch as u32 per spec ('Epoch as LE u32 bytes'), but select_channel_with_gnss() takes epoch as u8 and casts to u32 at line 221. If link-layer epoch values exceed 255, the hash-based channel selection in priority-2 path would produce different results than select_channel() for the same logical epoch, causing channel rendezvous failures between nodes using different code paths.
